data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD8: When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Description
Write a new integration test file `tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh` exercising the thread-resolution helpers and loop behavior with `gh` and the LLM API call shadowed by stub functions. Tests assert behavior (not text presence): dispatch counts, escalation conditions, and idempotent precheck.

## Files to Modify
- `tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh` (CREATE)

## TDD Test
Test names (each must initially fail with descriptive RED marker):
- `test_review_threads_query_parses_unresolved_thread_ids` — given a fixture GraphQL response with mixed resolved/unresolved threads, helper returns only unresolved IDs
- `test_resolve_thread_calls_mutation_only_when_unresolved` — given a thread with `isResolved=true`, the helper short-circuits without invoking the mutation; given `isResolved=false`, the mutation is invoked exactly once
- `test_settling_heuristic_requires_ci_green_and_zero_threads_and_quiet_window` — false when any condition unmet; true only when all three hold
- `test_dispatch_count_cap_triggers_escalation` — after 10 dispatches without settling, loop exits non-zero with PR url + unresolved IDs in stderr
- `test_wall_clock_cap_triggers_escalation` — after 30-minute simulated elapsed time, loop exits non-zero with same envelope
- `test_push_induced_dismissal_resets_poll_window` — when a code push between iterations triggers `dismiss_stale_approvals_on_push`, poll wall-clock window does not double-count restarted CI as a separate timeout

Stubbing strategy: place `tests/integration/stubs/gh` in `PATH` to capture `gh api graphql` and `gh pr ...` calls. LLM dispatch goes through `llm-api-call.sh`; stub similarly. Each stub records calls to a per-test temp file and returns canned JSON.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh
- [ ] Test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh
- [ ] All 6 tests are present (assertions execute the code path, not greps)
  Verify: grep -c '^test_' tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh | awk '$1>=6'
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED markers for the new test functions and source files (`merge-to-main-pr.sh` + `merge-helpers.sh`)
  Verify: grep -q 'merge-to-main-pr.sh.*\[test_review_threads_query_parses_unresolved_thread_ids\]' .test-index
- [ ] Tests follow behavioral standard — no source-file greps; assertions check exit codes, captured stub call logs, or stderr content

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
